data.raw_text:
Failure to Launch 

The attempt to destabilize the government through civil action was an epic fail.

Zaldy Co's flawed expose was supposed to trigger massive support for the weekend rallies.

The result:
1) INC couldn't call a million warm bodies.
2) DDS were barred from joining the INC rally
3) INC cut short its 3 day rally to 2 which removed the umbrella that would have hidden more sinister actions 
4) The EDSA rally barely had any attendees

Chavit, Guanzon and Imee's speeches got more hate than support.

Zaldy's maleta story is dead in the water. Sass and Sonza couldn't resurrect it even with the massive DDS troll farms.

Lacson's interpolation of Bernardo's affidavit and letter to the President took over the news. 

This effectively erased all the noise from the Zaldy Co expose. Heads rolled and roles were reversed in one week.

Zaldy Co the new DDS hero is back to being the villain that he is.

Marcos and Romualdez are exonerated.

Sara waiting in the wings for a coup d'etat that never happened goes back to the drawing board.
